operating_notes.text: HALMED inspection of Swiss Parenterals Unit-1 (liquid & dry powder injectables) and Unit-2 (betalactam dry powder injectables) resulted in procedural GMP observations under Directive (EU) 2017/1572.
Semaglutide launched under brand Sundae in Mar-2026 with strong initial market share.
Company received NCLT order for merger between subsidiaries Aprica, Eris Oaknet, and ETL with positive tax impact of ₹65 Cr.
Received approval to conduct Phase 1 and Phase 3 trials for India's first Recombinant Semaglutide.

timeline.summary: Croatia's HALMED issued procedural GMP non-compliance observations for Swiss Parenterals Units 1 and 2 following a March 2026 inspection.
India Ratings assigned IND AA/Stable/IND A1+ to ₹100 Cr and affirmed ₹420 Cr of bank loan facilities of Eris Therapeutics.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹756.56 Cr (+7.3% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹281.61 Cr (+200.1% YoY).
Eris Lifesciences reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹757 Cr and PAT of ₹279 Cr, up 173% YoY due to a deferred tax adjustment.
Eris Lifesciences Limited shared the earnings conference call recording for Q4 FY2026 on May 20, 2026, via its website.
Eris Lifesciences Limited’s shareholders approved resolutions via remote e-voting on May 23, 2026, with Mr. Ravi Kapoor submitting the Scrutinizer’s report on May 25, 2026.
Eris Lifesciences filed the transcript of the analyst and investor call for Q4 FY26 results on May 26, 2026.
Eris Lifesciences filed the annual promoter shareholding and encumbrance disclosure under Regulation 31(4) for FY26.
Eris Lifesciences received fines totaling ₹8.50 lakh from BSE and NSE for board composition non-compliance in Q4 FY26.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹892.37 Cr (+12.6% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹183.82 Cr (+52.9% YoY).
